svg.title: RealityForge: measure, recover, test, explore
svg.desc: A schematic method diagram for the default hybrid workflow. A video is tracked before the initial-window split. Initial observed positions determine a circle or line geometry, ParameterNet initialization and physical refinement. The recovered original model is checked against the remaining observed track. Separately, optional parameter edits rerun the same equations with the same geometry and time axis. No plotted marks are measured results.
svg.text: One object · fixed camera · two supported planar families

g.text: Positions (x, y) · timestamps t · confidence w
Tracking happens before this inference split.
Same geometry + time axis · conditional prediction
No edited parameters enter this check.
Schematic symbols, no measured curves. Local intervals are uncalibrated.
Pendulum recovers k = g/L, not separate g and L; sliding recovers image-plane acceleration.
Camera, scale, fitted geometry and model assumptions condition both branches.
